column2: Use a past-tense verb when you describe an earlier test result; use the present simple when you describe a continuing weakness.
column3: Oldingi test natijasini aytganda o‘tgan zamon, davom etayotgan kamchilik haqida gapirganda hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlating.
column4: Write four sentences: your starting strength, your weakest skill, one measurable weekly goal and your review date.
column5: To‘rtta gap yozing: dastlabki kuchli tomoningiz, eng zaif ko‘nikmangiz, haftalik o‘lchanadigan maqsadingiz va tekshirish sanasi.
column6: My reading is stronger than my listening. I missed dates in my first listening task. I will practise number dictation for fifteen minutes every morning. I will check my progress next Friday.
column7: O‘qishim tinglashimdan kuchliroq. Birinchi tinglash mashqida sanalarni eshitmay qoldim. Har kuni ertalab o‘n besh daqiqa raqamlarni eshitib yozishni mashq qilaman. Keyingi juma rivojlanishimni tekshiraman.
column8: Do not describe a single practice result as an official band score.
column9: Bitta mashq natijasini rasmiy IELTS bali deb ko‘rsatmang.

column2: A correction may replace an earlier answer: distinguish past options from the speaker's final choice.
column3: So‘zlovchi tuzatishi avvalgi javobni almashtirishi mumkin: oldingi variant bilan yakuniy tanlovni ajrating.
column4: Listen to the case, note the originally stated time, then identify the corrected time and explain your evidence.
column5: Vaziyatni tinglang, dastlab aytilgan vaqtni yozing, keyin tuzatilgan vaqtni topib, dalilingizni tushuntiring.
column6: I initially wrote Friday, but the speaker corrected the booking to Monday. The later statement is the final answer, so Monday is the date to record.
column7: Dastlab juma deb yozdim, ammo so‘zlovchi bandlovni dushanbaga tuzatdi. Keyingi bayonot yakuniy javob, shuning uchun dushanbani yozish kerak.
column8: Do not choose the first number or date you hear without checking whether it changes.
column9: O‘zgarish bor-yo‘qligini tekshirmasdan birinchi eshitgan raqam yoki sanani tanlamang.

column2: Use cautious reporting verbs such as suggests or indicates; a passage may support an inference without proving a universal claim.
column3: Suggests yoki indicates kabi ehtiyotkor ifodalarni ishlating; matn umumiy haqiqatni isbotlamasdan xulosaga ishora qilishi mumkin.
column4: For one paragraph, state its central claim, locate supporting words and distinguish FALSE from NOT GIVEN.
column5: Bitta xatboshi uchun asosiy fikrni ayting, dalil so‘zlarini toping va FALSE bilan NOT GIVEN ni farqlang.
column6: The paragraph claims that the new method saves energy. It gives an example from one factory, but says nothing about all factories. Therefore a statement about every factory is NOT GIVEN.
column7: Xatboshida yangi usul energiyani tejashi aytilgan. Bitta zavod misoli keltirilgan, ammo barcha zavodlar haqida hech narsa deyilmagan. Shu sababli hamma zavodlarga oid fikr NOT GIVEN bo‘ladi.
column8: Outside knowledge cannot turn an unstated statement into TRUE.
column9: Matndan tashqari bilim aytilmagan fikrni TRUE ga aylantirmaydi.

column2: Use by for the size of a change and to for its final value: rose by ten units versus rose to forty units.
column3: O‘zgarish miqdori uchun by, yakuniy qiymati uchun to ishlating: rose by ten units va rose to forty units.
column4: Describe one rise, one fall and the largest overall feature in a table or chart; do not invent causes.
column5: Jadval yoki grafikdagi bir o‘sish, bir pasayish va eng muhim umumiy xususiyatni tasvirlang; sabablarni o‘ylab topmang.
column6: Overall, online enrolment became the dominant category. It rose from twenty to forty percent, while classroom attendance declined slightly. The highest online figure was recorded in the final year.
column7: Umuman olganda, onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tish yetakchi toifaga aylandi. U yigirmadan qirq foizgacha oshdi, sinf qatnashuvi esa biroz kamaydi. Eng yuqori onlayn ko‘rsatkich oxirgi yilda qayd etilgan.
column8: Do not confuse ten percent with ten percentage points.
column9: O‘n foiz bilan o‘n foiz punktini chalkashtirmang.

column2: Build contrast with although, however and whereas, but connect each concession to your own position.
column3: Although, however va whereas yordamida qarama-qarshilik yarating, ammo har bir e’tirozni o‘z pozitsiyangizga bog‘lang.
column4: Write a position statement, supporting reason, counterargument and rebuttal on city transport investment.
column5: Shahar transportiga sarmoya mavzusida pozitsiya, dalil, qarshi fikr va unga javob yozing.
column6: I support more investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion. Critics worry about initial costs. However, cleaner and more reliable travel can create long-term savings, so the policy remains worthwhile.
column7: Tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkinligi sababli jamoat transportiga ko‘proq sarmoyani qo‘llab-quvvatlayman. Tanqidchilar dastlabki xarajatlardan xavotirda. Biroq tozaroq va ishonchliroq qatnov uzoq muddatda tejashga olib kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun siyosat foydali.
column8: Avoid a list of unrelated examples with no clear argument.
column9: Aniq dalilsiz aloqasiz misollar ro‘yxatidan qoching.

column2: Extend answers with because, for example and as a result; vary sentence structures instead of forcing memorised phrases.
column3: Javoblarni because, for example va as a result bilan kengaytiring; yodlangan iboralarni majburan ishlatmay, gap tuzilishini o‘zgartiring.
column4: Speak for one minute about a useful experience, then explain why similar experiences matter to other people.
column5: Foydali tajribangiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring, so‘ng bunday tajribalar boshqalar uchun nega muhimligini tushuntiring.
column6: A community project taught me to organise volunteers. At first I found it difficult to delegate tasks, but after a few meetings I became more confident. Similar experiences can help young people develop responsibility.
column7: Mahalla loyihasi menga ko‘ngillilarni tashkil etishni o‘rgatdi. Dastlab vazifalarni taqsimlash qiyin edi, ammo bir necha uchrashuvdan keyin ishonchim oshdi. Shunga o‘xshash tajribalar yoshlarning mas’uliyatini rivojlantirishi mumkin.
column8: A perfect transcript is not evidence of an IELTS speaking band score.
column9: Matnning to‘g‘ri tanilishi IELTS gapirish baliga dalil emas.

column2: Use conditionals to explain time choices: If I cannot locate the evidence quickly, I will return later.
column3: Vaqt qarorlarini ifodalashda shart gaplardan foydalaning: If I cannot locate the evidence quickly, I will return later.
column4: Run a short reading section with a timer; document two timing decisions and one correction.
column5: Qisqa o‘qish bo‘limini taymer bilan bajaring; ikki vaqt qarorini va bitta tuzatishni qayd eting.
column6: I skipped the longest question and returned after finishing easier items. This saved time, but I still made one spelling error. Next time I will reserve two minutes for checking.
column7: Eng uzun savolni vaqtincha o‘tkazib, osonlarini tugatgach qaytdim. Bu vaqtni tejadi, lekin bitta imlo xatosi qildim. Keyingi safar tekshirishga ikki daqiqa qoldiraman.
column8: Timed practice is not a full IELTS mock unless it includes every required section and task.
column9: Vaqtli mashq barcha zarur bo‘lim va topshiriqlarni o‘z ichiga olmasa, to‘liq IELTS sinovi emas.

column2: Use comparative structures to describe improvement: more accurate than before, fewer omissions and a clearer argument.
column3: Rivojlanishni taqqoslovchi tuzilmalar bilan ifodalang: more accurate than before, fewer omissions, a clearer argument.
column4: Choose your most frequent error, rewrite the wrong answer and justify the correction with a rule or evidence.
column5: Eng ko‘p takrorlangan xatoni tanlang, noto‘g‘ri javobni qayta yozing va tuzatishni qoida yoki dalil bilan asoslang.
column6: My answers were often too broad. I now identify the exact phrase in the text before choosing an option. This makes my explanations more precise and easier to verify.
column7: Javoblarim ko‘pincha juda umumiy edi. Endi variantni tanlashdan oldin matndagi aniq iborani topaman. Bu izohlarimni aniqroq va tekshirishni osonroq qiladi.
column8: Repeated practice without reviewing why answers were wrong produces limited improvement.
column9: Xatolarning sababini tekshirmay qayta-qayta mashq qilish kam rivojlanish beradi.

column2: Use higher than, lower than and twice as much as for comparisons; keep percentages and totals distinct.
column3: Taqqoslash uchun higher than, lower than va twice as much as ishlating; foiz bilan umumiy sonni farqlang.
column4: Summarise an imaginary six-category pie chart in an overview and two comparisons without inventing exact data.
column5: Olti toifali tasavvuriy doiraviy diagrammani umumiy xulosa va ikkita taqqoslash bilan bayon qiling, aniq ma’lumotni o‘ylab topmang.
column6: Food was the largest share, whereas entertainment was the smallest. Housing and transport together accounted for almost half of expenditure. The two smallest categories represented a minor proportion.
column7: Oziq-ovqat eng katta, ko‘ngilochar xarajatlar esa eng kichik ulush edi. Uy-joy va transport birgalikda xarajatlarning deyarli yarmini tashkil etdi. Ikki eng kichik toifaning ulushi oz edi.
column8: Do not supply made-up numbers as if a chart actually showed them.
column9: Grafikda bo‘lmagan raqamlarni go‘yoki ko‘rsatilgandek yozmang.

column2: Present-simple passive forms describe processes: the material is heated, the pieces are sorted, the product is packed.
column3: Jarayonlar hozirgi oddiy zamonning majhul nisbatida ifodalanadi: the material is heated, the pieces are sorted, the product is packed.
column4: Write an overview and a six-stage description of recycling from collection to final packaging.
column5: Yig‘ishdan yakuniy qadoqlashgacha bo‘lgan qayta ishlashning umumiy xulosasi va olti bosqichli tavsifini yozing.
column6: Overall, used containers are transformed into reusable material through a sequence of mechanical and heating stages. Initially, they are collected and sorted. The material is cleaned, processed, shaped and finally packed.
column7: Umuman olganda, ishlatilgan idishlar mexanik va isitish bosqichlari orqali qayta foydalanish mumkin bo‘lgan materialga aylantiriladi. Dastlab ular yig‘ilib saralanadi. Material tozalanadi, qayta ishlanadi, shakllantiriladi va oxirida qadoqlanadi.
column8: A process description should not invent temperatures or machinery absent from the diagram.
column9: Jarayon tavsifiga sxemada yo‘q harorat yoki uskunani qo‘shmang.

column2: Reporting verbs reveal certainty: the student suggested a change, the lecturer confirmed a deadline and the group questioned the method.
column3: Xabar beruvchi fe’llar ishonch darajasini bildiradi: the student suggested, the lecturer confirmed, the group questioned.
column4: Listen to or read the seminar, list the proposed method, the objection and the group's final decision.
column5: Seminarni tinglang yoki o‘qing, taklif etilgan usulni, e’tirozni va guruhning yakuniy qarorini yozing.
column6: The students first proposed online interviews. Their supervisor raised concerns about the sample, so they decided to add face-to-face interviews. They will confirm the revised plan next week.
column7: Talabalar avval onlayn suhbatlarni taklif qilishdi. Ilmiy rahbar tanlanmadan xavotir bildirdi, shuning uchun ular yuzma-yuz suhbatlarni qo‘shishga qaror qilishdi. Yangilangan rejani keyingi hafta tasdiqlashadi.
column8: Do not treat a tentative suggestion as a final agreement.
column9: Taxminiy taklifni yakuniy kelishuv deb qabul qilmang.

column2: Use polite questions with could or would when requesting practical information from a service provider.
column3: Xizmat ko‘rsatuvchidan amaliy ma’lumot so‘raganda could yoki would bilan muloyim savollar tuzing.
column4: Write a short enquiry about an evening course, including two questions and your preferred contact method.
column5: Kechki kurs haqida ikki savol va afzal aloqa usulingizni kiritib qisqa so‘rov yozing.
column6: I am interested in your evening English classes. Could you confirm the start date and the total fee? I would prefer to receive the details by email because I work during the day.
column7: Kechki ingliz tili darslaringizga qiziqaman. Boshlanish sanasi va umumiy to‘lovni tasdiqlab bera olasizmi? Kunduzi ishlaganim uchun ma’lumotni elektron pochta orqali olishni afzal ko‘raman.
column8: General Training reading and writing tasks differ from Academic, although both share the same listening and speaking tests.
column9: General Training ning o‘qish va yozish topshiriqlari Academic dan farq qiladi, ammo tinglash va gapirish bir xil.

column2: Questions using when and where require the exact revised time or location; do not add unsupported details.
column3: When va where bilan tuzilgan savollar yangilangan aniq vaqt yoki joyni talab qiladi; asossiz tafsilot qo‘shmang.
column4: Take notes on a rental phone call: deposit amount, viewing date and contact detail.
column5: Ijara telefon suhbati bo‘yicha qaydlar qiling: garov miqdori, ko‘rish sanasi va aloqa ma’lumoti.
column6: The caller asks about a flat viewing and receives two possible dates. She selects Thursday afternoon and confirms the deposit requirement. She then repeats the telephone number to avoid a mistake.
column7: Qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan ayol kvartirani ko‘rish haqida so‘raydi va ikkita sana eshitadi. U payshanba tushdan keyinni tanlab, garov talabini tasdiqlaydi. Keyin xatoga yo‘l qo‘ymaslik uchun telefon raqamini takrorlaydi.
column8: Numbers that sound alike need extra attention, especially thirteen and thirty.
column9: O‘xshash eshitiladigan raqamlar, ayniqsa thirteen va thirty, alohida diqqat talab qiladi.

column2: Modals in notices express obligations and permission: must attend, may apply and should contact.
column3: E’lonlarda modal fe’llar majburiyat va ruxsatni bildiradi: must attend, may apply, should contact.
column4: Compare two workplace notices and state one compulsory action, one optional action and an application deadline.
column5: Ikkita ish e’lonini solishtirib, bitta majburiy, bitta ixtiyoriy amalni va ariza muddatini ayting.
column6: Staff must complete safety training before entering the workshop. Experienced employees may apply for the supervisor course. Applications close on the final Friday of the month.
column7: Xodimlar ustaxonaga kirishdan oldin xavfsizlik mashg‘ulotini tugatishi shart. Tajribali xodimlar rahbarlik kursiga ariza berishlari mumkin. Arizalar oyning oxirgi juma kunida yopiladi.
column8: Do not interpret may as an obligation or must as a suggestion.
column9: May ni majburiyat, must ni oddiy tavsiya deb talqin qilmang.

column2: Formal letters use complete sentences with polite conditionals: I would appreciate it if you could...
column3: Rasmiy xatlarda muloyim shartli tuzilmalar bilan to‘liq gaplar ishlatiladi: I would appreciate it if you could...
column4: Write a formal service request covering the reason, relevant background and expected action.
column5: Sabab, zarur ma’lumot va kutilgan harakatni qamrab olgan rasmiy xizmat so‘rovi yozing.
column6: I am writing to request a repair appointment because the heating system has stopped working. The fault began on Tuesday and affects two rooms. I would appreciate it if you could arrange an inspection this week.
column7: Isitish tizimi ishlamay qolgani sababli ta’mirlash uchrashuvini so‘rab yozyapman. Nosozlik seshanba kuni boshlangan va ikki xonaga ta’sir qilmoqda. Shu hafta tekshiruvni tashkil etsangiz minnatdor bo‘lardim.
column8: Avoid slang, missing bullet points and abrupt commands in a formal letter.
column9: Rasmiy xatda jargon, tushib qolgan bandlar va qo‘pol buyruqlardan saqlaning.

column2: Use concession structures such as while some people argue and nevertheless to make a reasoned position clear.
column3: Asosli pozitsiya uchun while some people argue va nevertheless kabi e’tirozli tuzilmalarni ishlating.
column4: Create two body-paragraph topic sentences about affordable housing and explain one trade-off.
column5: Hamyonbop uy-joy haqida ikki asosiy xatboshi mavzu gapini tuzing va bitta muvozanat muammosini tushuntiring.
column6: Affordable homes can help workers remain close to employment. However, new developments require investment in transport and services. Authorities should consider housing and infrastructure together rather than separately.
column7: Hamyonbop uylar ishchilarga ish joyiga yaqin yashash imkonini beradi. Biroq yangi qurilishlar transport va xizmatlarga sarmoyani talab qiladi. Hokimiyat uy-joy va infratuzilmani alohida emas, birgalikda ko‘rib chiqishi lozim.
column8: An essay must answer the actual question rather than only mention its topic.
column9: Insho mavzuni eslatish bilangina cheklanmay, berilgan savolga javob berishi kerak.

column2: Use past simple for completed events and past continuous for background action when telling a personal story.
column3: Shaxsiy hikoyada tugagan voqealar uchun past simple, davom etgan fon harakati uchun past continuous ishlating.
column4: Describe a memorable local event with its setting, an unexpected detail, your reaction and a lesson learned.
column5: Mahalliy esda qolarli voqeani joyi, kutilmagan tafsiloti, reaksiyangiz va olgan sabog‘ingiz bilan tasvirlang.
column6: I was helping at a neighbourhood event when the electricity stopped. We moved the activities outdoors and continued by daylight. The experience showed me how cooperation can solve a practical problem.
column7: Mahalla tadbirida yordam berayotganimda elektr o‘chdi. Mashg‘ulotlarni tashqariga ko‘chirib, kunduzgi yorug‘likda davom etdik. Bu tajriba hamkorlik amaliy muammoni hal qila olishini ko‘rsatdi.
column8: An answer containing only one memorised sentence cannot demonstrate sustained speaking.
column9: Faqat bitta yodlangan gap uzoq davom etuvchi gapirish ko‘nikmasini ko‘rsatmaydi.

column2: Time clauses with before and after clarify the order of actions: review questions before the recording begins.
column3: Before va after bilan tuzilgan vaqt gaplari amallar ketma-ketligini aniqlaydi: review questions before the recording begins.
column4: Write your timing plan for a short reading and writing study session, then record where you lost time.
column5: Qisqa o‘qish va yozish mashg‘uloti uchun vaqt rejasi tuzing, so‘ng vaqt qayerda ketganini qayd eting.
column6: I allocated twenty minutes to the reading exercise and thirty minutes to writing. I finished reading early but spent too long revising the introduction. Next time I will limit planning and keep more time for proofreading.
column7: O‘qishga yigirma, yozishga o'ttiz daqiqa ajratdim. O‘qishni erta tugatdim, ammo kirishni tuzatishga ko‘p vaqt sarfladim. Keyingi safar rejalashni cheklab, tekshirishga ko‘proq vaqt qoldiraman.
column8: A short timed drill must not be advertised as a full official IELTS mock test.
column9: Qisqa vaqtli mashq to‘liq rasmiy IELTS sinovi sifatida ko‘rsatilmasligi kerak.

column2: Use comparative and corrective language: the first draft lacked detail, whereas the revision explains the request.
column3: Taqqoslovchi va tuzatuvchi tilni ishlating: the first draft lacked detail, whereas the revision explains the request.
column4: Revise a weak complaint letter by adding its missing date, requested solution and appropriate closing.
column5: Zaif shikoyat xatini yetishmayotgan sana, so‘ralgan yechim va mos yakun bilan tuzating.
column6: The first draft only said that the service was bad. I added the delivery date, described the faulty item and requested a repair. The revised letter is more useful because it gives the reader a clear action.
column7: Birinchi qoralamada faqat xizmat yomonligi aytilgan. Men yetkazish sanasini qo‘shdim, nosoz buyumni tasvirladim va ta’mirlashni so‘radim. Tuzatilgan xat o‘quvchiga aniq harakatni ko‘rsatgani uchun foydaliroq.
column8: Changing a few adjectives does not solve a missing task requirement.
column9: Bir nechta sifatni almashtirish vazifaning yetishgan shartini to‘ldirmaydi.

column2: Indirect questions sound more courteous in formal correspondence: Could you tell me whether the classes are available?
column3: Rasmiy yozishmada bilvosita savollar muloyimroq bo‘ladi: Could you tell me whether the classes are available?
column4: Compose a formal information request with a subject, three focused questions and a suitable closing line.
column5: Mavzu, uchta aniq savol va mos yakuniy jumla bilan rasmiy so‘rov yozing.
column6: I am writing to enquire about the professional training programme. Could you confirm the timetable, total cost and entry requirements? I would be grateful for a reply before registration closes.
column7: Kasbiy ta’lim dasturi haqida so‘rab yozyapman. Jadval, umumiy narx va kirish talablarini tasdiqlab bera olasizmi? Ro‘yxat yopilishidan oldin javob bersangiz minnatdor bo‘laman.
column8: Do not use an excessively casual greeting for an unknown official recipient.
column9: Notanish rasmiy qabul qiluvchiga juda norasmiy salomlashuv ishlatmang.

column2: Words like unless and except can reverse eligibility conditions; identify their scope in the sentence.
column3: Unless va except kabi so‘zlar muvofiqlik shartlarini o‘zgartirishi mumkin; gapdagi ta’sir doirasini aniqlang.
column4: Read a workplace policy and write who must attend training, who may apply and which exception applies.
column5: Ish joyi qoidasini o‘qib, kim treningga majburiy, kim ariza bera olishi va qaysi istisno borligini yozing.
column6: All new employees must complete the induction. Experienced staff may request additional training unless the programme is full. Temporary workers are exempt from the optional workshop.
column7: Barcha yangi xodimlar tanishtiruv mashg‘ulotini tugatishi shart. Tajribali xodimlar dastur to‘lmagan bo‘lsa qo‘shimcha trening so‘rashi mumkin. Vaqtinchalik ishchilar ixtiyoriy mashg‘ulotdan ozod etiladi.
column8: Never infer a policy that the notice does not actually state.
column9: E’londa aytilmagan qoidani taxmin qilmang.

column2: Formal complaints benefit from a factual chronology with first, subsequently and despite this.
column3: Rasmiy shikoyatda first, subsequently va despite this bilan faktik ketma-ketlik yaratish foydali.
column4: Write a complaint that identifies the purchase, reports the defect and requests a specific remedy.
column5: Xaridni aniqlaydigan, nosozlikni xabar qiladigan va aniq yechim so‘raydigan shikoyat yozing.
column6: I purchased a washing machine on Monday, but it stopped working two days later. I contacted support and followed the troubleshooting steps without success. I therefore request a replacement under the warranty.
column7: Dushanba kuni kir yuvish mashinasi sotib oldim, ammo ikki kundan so‘ng ishlamay qoldi. Yordam xizmatiga bog‘lanib, ko‘rsatmalarni bajardim, lekin natija bo‘lmadi. Shu sababli kafolat bo‘yicha almashtirishni so‘rayman.
column8: An angry tone without evidence weakens an otherwise justified complaint.
column9: Dalilsiz g‘azabli ohang asosli shikoyatning ham kuchini kamaytiradi.
